articles.title: Crypto PAC's $12 million Senate candidate, Barry Moore, wins Alabama GOP primary
articles.snippet: The Trump loyalist drew more crypto dollars than any candidate so far in this year's midterms, and the result marks a big win for the industry's political arm.

articles.title: CoinMENA, Standard Chartered partner on UAE payment rails
articles.snippet: CoinMENA will use Standard Chartered to strengthen fiat payment rails in the UAE, while Revolut reportedly secured central bank licenses ahead of a planned local launch.

articles.title: Congress reaches deal on housing bill with CBDC ban until 2030
articles.snippet: The US could soon temporarily ban a central bank digital currency, as House and Senate leaders came to a deal on the 21st Century Road to Housing Act.

articles.title: Senators urge Treasury to ensure state authority in GENIUS application
articles.snippet: A bipartisan group of US senators told the Treasury that its application of stablecoin laws should be done in a way that “preserves and promotes State participation.”

articles.title: Crypto PAC has $12M stake in Senate primary runoff as Alabama voters head to polls
articles.snippet: Defend American Jobs reported spending $7.4 million on media to support Republican Barry Moore ahead of his May 19 Alabama primary, and an additional $4.7 million before Tuesday’s runoffs.
